series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits a downward trend with moderate strength and moderate seasonality, but high noise and unpredictability (spectral entropy > 0.85) suggest robust baseline methods like median are appropriate. Unstable rankings and significant RMSE spread indicate model performance varies substantially, warranting avoidance of complex combinations.

reasoning.robust_median: series_profile.noise.unpredictable=true AND spectral_entropy=0.8588 → robust_median is recommended for high-noise, near-white-noise series (Goerg 2013)
reasoning.trimmed_mean_r0.10: series_profile.model_landscape.rankings_stable=false (kendall_tau=-0.3918) → trimmed mean with moderate trim ratio (0.10) is robust to unstable rankings (Genre et al. 2013)
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.model_landscape.rmse_spread_ratio=0.755 AND rankings_stable=false → inverse-RMSE weights with shrinkage (0.35) balances performance weighting with regularization (Hansen et al. 2011)

excluded_highlights.stl_hierarchical_stacking_p2_sh0.0: series_profile.combination_recommendation.avoid contains 'stl_hierarchical_stacking' due to high noise and unpredictable series
excluded_highlights.ridge_stacking_l250_topk3: series_profile.combination_recommendation.avoid contains 'ridge_stacking' for high-noise series with few validation windows
